L3/L4 had no recorded rows for W=27 (fresh exhaustive verify too heavy) and back_annotate returned no_measured_data, so no winner change and no reexplore. Lesson: for very tight error bounds the feasible region collapses to a near-single design; the constraint is met exactly rather than with margin, so any calibration shift in the error model would push it infeasible.
